name: Wine
notes: DRAFT. From the vineyards, once a year in Autumn.

name: Olive oil
notes: DRAFT. From the olive groves, pressed in Winter.

name: Fleece
notes: DRAFT. Sheared in Spring. The weavers turn it into cloth.

name: Cloth
notes: DRAFT. Woven from fleece. Tunics for recruits, sails for ships.

name: Timber
notes: DRAFT. Oak and pine from the hills above the bay. Almost every building needs it.

name: Salt
notes: DRAFT. From salt pans on the shore, in Summer. The fishery needs it to salt the catch.

name: Salted fish
notes: DRAFT. Salted catch from the fishery; sells well in Italy.

name: Iron
notes: DRAFT. From a mine in the hills, or bought in Aquileia (Noric iron). Weapons, tools, ship nails.

name: Tin
notes: DRAFT. Only by sea. With copper it makes bronze.

name: Bronze
notes: DRAFT. Only by sea. Fittings for the temple and the baths.

name: Marble
notes: DRAFT. Brač stone from near Salona, or Greek marble through Brundisium. Temple and baths.

name: Amber
notes: DRAFT. Comes down the Amber Road from the Baltic to Aquileia.

name: Pepper
notes: DRAFT. From India by way of Egypt and Italy.

name: Purple cloth
notes: DRAFT. Dyed with murex; worn by the great.
